label: PF Backlog 498
title: Hardening: pre-push hook runs the backlog id-audit (catch duplicates at the push boundary too)
body:
Source: user request (2026-10-08). Hardening on top of BI-PF-0457 (duplicate-id merge audit) + BI-PF-0462
(id allocator).

WHAT: install a `pre-push` git hook (via scripts/dev/install_hooks.py) that runs
`scripts/dev/backlog_id_audit.py` before every push, so a duplicate backlog id is caught at the PUSH boundary
too - not only at precheck/CI. Belt-and-braces (defense-in-depth): the allocator PREVENTS collisions; precheck/CI
and the pre-push hook CATCH any residue at two independent boundaries.

Acceptance: install_hooks.py writes .git/hooks/pre-push; the hook fails the push (exit 1) when the id audit
fails, passes otherwise; no opencode/dashboard references.
